project_info.theme: Toyota cabin spaciousness for children and family comfort
project_info.color_palette: Warm beige, charcoal, soft green, white

main_subject.detail: A close lifestyle poster of a smiling young child seated comfortably in a child safety seat inside the rear cabin of a Toyota. The child reaches a hand toward the camera, creating a depth-of-field foreground effect. Large bottom-left text reads 'RONG RAI TRON KHONG GIAN'. The car interior is softly lit with green park scenery outside the windows.
main_subject.style: Intimate family-comfort poster with close-up portrait framing, shallow depth cue, and cozy cabin atmosphere

items: Top Left: Soft upper cabin shadows and headrest framing
Top Right: Out-of-focus green park scenery through the rear window
Bottom Left: Large beige-and-white caption 'RONG RAI TRON KHONG GIAN'
Bottom Right: Child seat harness buckle and rear seat contours
Center/Background: Close-up child in a secure child seat reaching an open hand toward the camera

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle face illumination, cozy upholstery texture, warm family-comfort mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Toyota family cabin comfort. Centerpiece is a smiling child secured in a child safety seat inside a Toyota rear cabin, reaching one hand toward the camera. Background is the softly lit interior with green outdoor scenery blurred through the windows. Surrounding elements: exact text 'RONG RAI TRON KHONG GIAN'. Technical style: photoreal close-up family-lifestyle automotive image, soft natural cabin lighting, cozy upholstery texture and warm comfort mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Child portrait in safety seat
assets.usage: Preserve the exact facial expression, hand-to-camera gesture, and child-seat posture

assets.name: Child safety seat and rear-cabin upholstery reference
assets.usage: Maintain the exact child-seat shape, harness, and cabin comfort context

assets.name: Close-up spaciousness comfort layout
assets.usage: Keep the large bottom-left caption and the intimate portrait crop

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Do not widen this into a generic full-car interior shot. The close-up of the child reaching toward the camera is the emotional hook and must remain central.
